title: TesseraQL bench scenario (bench/*.yml)
$comment: Deliberately open (additionalProperties: true): newer keys never break older editors. tesseraql lint holds the keys against the model, and refuses an unknown route, an undeclared param, or a write without writes: allowed.

description.description: What the scenario measures; printed with the report.

concurrency.description: Workers in the closed loop (default 10). With rate:, the bound on requests in flight.

duration.description: How long the run lasts, e.g. 30s or 2m (default 30s).

rampUp.description: The span the workers start across, e.g. 5s. None by default.

rate.description: Open loop: requests per second offered, instead of the closed loop's concurrency.

writes.description: Required before a request may drive a route that is not GET or HEAD; the harness then mints an Idempotency-Key per request.

route.description: The route id, as tesseraql routes lists it.

params.description: The route's declared inputs: path placeholders first, the rest the query string.

body.description: The JSON body a write sends.

weight.description: How often this request is chosen relative to the others (default 1).
